title: Man dies after attackers trap hands in car windows, drag him for 1.5km - video
content: A 37-year-old man, Biru Singh Bhadauriya, died after being assaulted in Kanpur's Hanumant Vihar area. The attack happened on Tuesday night when he was returning home from a Dussehra fair. His assailants allegedly trapped his hands in the car windows and dragged him for 1.5 kilometers. After the incident, Bhadauriya was taken to Lala Lajpat Rai Hospital where he later died.

title: Google co-founder Larry Page leaves California ahead of billionaire tax vote
content: As Californians gear up to cast their votes on Proposition 40, which suggests a one-time tax on billionaires, notable figures like Larry Page have relocated their businesses far from the state's reach to evade this tax burden. While the tax could potentially rake in $100 billion, the exodus of these wealthy individuals—who would collectively owe around $29 billion—poses a serious threat to California's expected income from this tax initiative.

title: Wife’s father paid for joint house; Kerala HC orders husband to vacate

title: Sheetal Devi, Toman Kumar win compound mixed team gold at Asian Para Games

The Indian pair defeated Indonesia’s Teodora Audi Ayudia Ferelly and Ken Swagumilang 151-148 in the final. The top-seeded Indian team stayed ahead for most of the contest and held on to win by three points.

title: Paid Rs 1 lakh for gold chain, got nothing; jeweller ordered to pay Rs 1.3 lakh

Meanwhile, Iranian officials warn of severe responses if attacked, emphasizing improved missile capabilities.

title: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen's $640K charity donations spark scrutiny

title: Man finds black rubber piece in juice bottle, wins Rs 22,340 from consumer court
